contract.title: ERA5 pressure-level January 2024 temperature and geopotential fields
contract.intent: Request a small ERA5 hourly pressure-level slice with temperature at 500 and 850 hPa and geopotential at 500 hPa for January 2024 sampled every 3 hours.
contract.summary: Copernicus Climate Data Store ERA5 pressure-level reanalysis subset for 2024-01-01 through 2024-01-31, UTC times 00:00, 03:00, 06:00, 09:00, 12:00, 15:00, 18:00, and 21:00, with global coverage by default.
credential_requirements: CDS API credential name only: CDS_API_TOKEN

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: Temperature on the 500 hPa pressure level.

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: Temperature on the 850 hPa pressure level.

fields.name: geopotential
fields.description: Geopotential on the 500 hPa pressure level.

defaults_used: Selected product_type='reanalysis' as the standard deterministic ERA5 product.
Used global spatial coverage because no sub-region was specified.
Interpreted the date range as inclusive.
Interpreted 'every 3 hours' as UTC synoptic times 00:00 through 21:00 at 3-hour intervals.
Kept variable units unset because they were not provided in the supplied inventory.
assumptions: The intended workflow uses pressure-level fields only, not ERA5 single-level fields.
The selected variables, pressure levels, year, month, days, and times were validated against the provided DatasetInventory option space.
No spatial subset was provided, so the CDS default global area is used.
risks_or_unknowns: A scientist may want to replace the global area with a smaller region to reduce file size and request time.
The contract does not specify unit conversion, vertical interpolation, temporal alignment beyond selected UTC timestamps, train/validation/test splitting, or ML field roles.
The supplied inventory confirms selectable variable names and pressure levels but does not provide variable units or long metadata for each selected variable.

evidence.title: CDS Retrieve API process metadata
evidence.note: Official machine-readable request schema confirming dataset id, available request fields, selectable variables, pressure levels, times, product types, area default, and data/download formats.

evidence.title: ERA5 hourly data on pressure levels from 1940 to present
evidence.note: Official CDS dataset page confirming dataset title, provider context, availability, DOI, and CC-BY licence listing.

contract.recommended_next_step: Ask the human to confirm whether global coverage is intended or to provide a smaller bounding box before generating the retrieval request.

candidate.name: ERA5 hourly data on pressure levels
candidate.description: Copernicus Climate Data Store ERA5 reanalysis dataset on pressure levels.
candidate.user_goal: Draft a small pressure-level ERA5 contract matching this intended workflow: temperature at 500 hPa, temperature at 850 hPa, and geopotential at 500 hPa; start_date is 2024-01-01; end_date is 2024-01-31; timestep is every 3 hours. Keep remaining choices minimal and human-editable.
